verdict.rationale: Close's docs say workflows can be managed with sequences and bulk actions and that email can be sent from the platform (close-docs-3). There is a bulk email action endpoint (close-docs-26), and pricing lists automated workflows and bulk email sending (close-docs-30), so multi-step sequences and bulk outreach are documented first-party capabilities. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of email templates, detailed documentation of sequence step configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
